generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

architecture.transition:
ResidualTransition(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=68, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
  )
)
architecture.decoder:
ObservationDecoder(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=7, bias=True)
  )
)

training.optimizer: joint Adam defaults lr=.0003 betas=.9/.999 eps=1e-8; no clipping
training.loss: uniform mean allwindows,k0..10,7dimensions normalized observation MSE; no latent teacher/auxiliary loss
training.order_rule: default_rng(seed0).permutation(Train complete episodes); all legal K10 starts per16episodebatch
training.backpropagation: full causal prefix and10step latent recursion; no detach, no future input or decoder feedback

initialization.conversion: one-time affine folding into T/D weights; no runtime latent normalization

initial_function_equivalence.probe_rule: fixed linspace rawz[-1,1] 8x64 and normalized action[-1,1] 8x4; no Test selection

windows.protocol: all starts t in range(max(0,N-H+1)), per episode

pi_magnitude_bins.rule: Train transition PI norm tertiles; small<q1, q1<=medium<q2, large>=q2

selected_window.rule: first Test episode eligible for max horizon; midpoint legal start, no performance selection

protocol: true causal prefix -> current rawz; T-only recursion with recorded actions; D readout no feedback
objective: uniform mean normalized observation MSE over all windows, k0..10 and7dimensions; no latent target or auxiliary loss
interpretation: deterministic latent dynamics core only, not Dreamer/full MBRL or world-model agent
limitations: Single seed nominal simulation recorded actions and overlapping windows; K10/.4s training, no reward/policy/planning.
Joint fine-tuning changes all3components and loss; component-specific causal attribution is not isolated.
Old teacher-latent Decoder Floor is historical, not a Joint floor; joint reconstruction and latent consistency are offline diagnostics.
Post-training Train latent std is diagnostic only; no fixed old latent coordinate constraint, latent teacher or consistency training.
Raw yaw coordinate error unchanged; horizon cohorts differ but identical across models at each horizon; commonH50 cohort also saved.

measured_assessment.summary: Joint adaptation improves current reconstruction and H1/5/10/25 observation prediction versus Frozen Explicit, but H50 is substantially worse. This is a mixed result, not successful autonomous long-horizon propagation.
measured_assessment.best_epoch_selection: Epoch60 is the Validation k0..10 MSE minimum within the prescribed60epochs. No Test-based selection, further epoch or model change.
measured_assessment.reconstruction: Joint normalized current reconstruction RMSE=.03828649 versus historical frozen E/D=.078243. Reconstruction is improved, not collapsed; neither is a strict autonomous-rollout floor.
measured_assessment.regions: AtH50 all four distance groups and all three PI-magnitude groups are worse than Frozen Explicit. Large-PI joint/frozen/direct RMSE=.737618/.515258/.373594. Near-target <.1m=.243606/.202252/.048713, only80windows.
measured_assessment.latent_drift: Same-Joint-coordinate offline cosine decreases .996376 atH1 to .878943 atH50, with Train-scale distance .109955 to .749678. This accompanies observation drift, but is not a causal attribution or cross-model latent-coordinate comparison.
measured_assessment.collapse: Train/Test near-zero-variance latent dimensions=0/64 atstd<1e-6; effective covariance ranks12.2857/12.0732, all dimensions vary. No evidence of global latent collapse; lower effective rank alone does not establish collapse.
measured_assessment.numerics: NoNaN/Inf or observed explosion; Test prediction absolute max5.774427 and latent norm max4.629386. Allthree module gradients are finite/nonzero and allparameter hashes changed.
measured_assessment.causal_limits: This experiment jointly changes encoder, transition, decoder and observation objective. It cannot identify a specific module as the cause, establish Markov-state completeness, or prove stochastic transition is necessary.
measured_assessment.next_recommendation_only: Keep the deterministic formulation for a separately authorized read-only analysis of K10-to-H50 composition/latent consistency before a stochastic state-space formulation. Do not execute further training or planning.
